{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.16

|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Set an object's water intake ratio when immersed.

|s1= obj [[setWaterLeakiness]] leakiness

|p1= obj: [[Object]] - object to manipulate

|p2= leakiness: [[Number]] - in range 0..1 where 0 is waterproof and 1 is full leak

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
private _veh = vehicle player;
if (surfaceIsWater getPosASL _veh) then
{
	_veh setWaterLeakiness 1;
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getWaterLeakiness]] [[setWaterFillPercentage]] [[getWaterFillPercentage]]
}}
